verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers dedicated APIs for accounting-adjacent data—Card Expenses API (retrieve/sync expenses to ERP/accounting systems) and Bills API (manage vendor invoices)—giving developers programmatic access to spend/accounts-payable data. However, there's no evidence of a broader general-ledger or full accounting-data API (e.g., chart of accounts, journal entries, reconciliation exports beyond bills/expenses). Missing for 10: evidence of a comprehensive accounting/ledger API beyond bills and card expenses, and independent developer corroboration of real-world accounting integration use.
